items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: they called Shine Kim in the band

ctx.x: And, uh, Jim Robison, Sidney Brown, John O'Dea, Rudolph played a while, and after, uh, they got rid of Rudolph. And, uh, boy, they called Shine Kim in the band. Now, Nolan Williams was his name. Oh, it was. I guess you heard that name. That's right. Jim Robison has a picture.
